'''3638 BBY''' was the fifth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around that time, the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] attempted to assert itself as a third power in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the [[Dread Masters]]'s plans for galactic annihilation were halted on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]].

==Events==
*The [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], under [[Toborro]], tried to become a third interstellar power like the Republic and Sith Empire and conquered [[Makeb]], but in end the Hutt's plan failed, and the Cartel allied itself to the Republic.
*The rogue [[Dread Masters]] were annihilated on [[Oricon]].
